cases.name: Crystal Lyn Bailey
cases.about: Her family described Bailey as an honor student with a sweet personality who never raised her voice or got mad at anyone. Even Assistant District Attorney Bill Wood said that everyone involved in the case, even McDonald's family, had nothing but kind things to say about Bailey.`Everyone has said without exception that she is the sweetest child they ever met,' Wood said.
